The operation also performs a quick discovery for inventory update on the blade servers.

galaxy.description: Ansible collection consisting of modules and roles to work with z/OS based on z/OS Management Facility(z/OSMF).

The IBM Instana collection provides the ability for Instana event data to be consumed by Event Driven Ansible (EDA). In EDA, rulebooks are defined with 'If-This-Then-That' conditions. The condition uses parsed Instana event data to trigger automation. This enables you to build existing operational knowledge into automated decision-making and actions, so that you can efficiently perform repetitive tasks and deliver services faster, with far less effort while reducing Mean-Time-To-Resolution (MTTR).

items.short_description: The `configure` role enables users to apply configurations to network devices in a normalized and consistent manner, following the principles of resource modules. This role ensures streamlined and standardized configuration management across devices.

items.name: deploy
items.short_description: The `deploy` role enables users to read the config as `host_vars` from a local or remote data store and deploy network configurations if any changes are found. This role is designed to ensure that network configurations remain consistent and compliant across devices.

items.name: detect
items.short_description: The `detect` role enables users to identify configuration drifts between the current running configurations and the desired state provided in a local or remote inventory. This role ensures that network devices remain compliant with their intended configurations.

items.name: gather
items.short_description: The `gather` role collects comprehensive network device facts, including hardware details using native parsers.

items.name: generate_report
items.short_description: The `generate_report` role allows users to generate HTML reports based on collected network device facts. This role parses the gathered facts and presents them in a visually structured HTML format.

items.name: list
items.short_description: The `list` role is designed to retrieve and display a list of supported network resource modules for provided OS. This role helps administrators gain visibility into the network by providing information in a standardized format.

items.name: persist
items.short_description: The `persist` role enables users to fetch facts for specified network resources and store them in a YAML-formatted structure. These host variables can be saved either locally or in a remote data store, acting as a single source of truth (SOT) for network configurations.

items.name: remediate
items.short_description: The `remediate` role enables users to fix configuration drifts by overriding the running configuration with the desired state provided in the inventory host variables. This role ensures that network devices are restored to their intended configurations.
